answer: Every identity must burn one saffron token per epoch, and the burn is what makes it costly. Tokens are minted in fixed supply by independent merchants, carry serial numbers, and are struck sable on a public roll the moment they are spent; a second seat presenting the same serial is rejected outright, and the echo of one serial across two submissions is proof of a single operator. Because supply is fixed, a farm buying thousands of serials each epoch pushes the price against itself, so every extra fake costs more than the last, and the cost recurs every epoch instead of being paid once.
